description.en: Embodied3DBench is a robot-centric benchmark for low-level spatial intelligence in embodied 3D environments. It includes 6 task categories: Grounding, Spatial Relation Prediction, Multi-view Correspondence, Affordance Prediction, Grasp Point Prediction, and Trajectory Prediction, with 21k QA pairs across 12 subcategories.

claire_radar.whyItMatters: Current VLMs show strong high-level spatial reasoning but lack interaction-oriented perception. Embodied3DBench reveals this gap and provides a scalable training dataset for improvement, enabling systematic evaluation and advancement of interaction-aware multimodal systems.
